W3C CSS 2, Appendix D: “Default style sheet for HTML 4”

The W3C’s informative sample style sheet that writes down how browsers render unstyled HTML.

Source
W3C, CSS 2.1 specification
Creator
World Wide Web Consortium (W3C)
Made
1998 (CSS 2); 2011 (CSS 2.1 Recommendation)
Style
Brutalist web design (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Plain, utilitarian
Evidence
Read the appendix on 2026-10-02. The dates are the publication years of the CSS 2 and CSS 2.1 Recommendations as generally cited; the page itself was not checked for its date line.
Reviewed
2 October 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The appendix lists body { margin: 8px }, h1 { font-size: 2em; margin: .67em 0 }, h2 { font-size: 1.5em; margin: .75em 0 }, blockquote { margin-left: 40px; margin-right: 40px }, and :link, :visited { text-decoration: underline }.

The current equivalent is the Rendering section of the HTML Living Standard.

Why it belongs

The sizes here explain the narrow type scale in the Brutalist web design fingerprint: the largest default heading is twice the body size.

Borrow

Start from these values instead of a reset. Change only what the content needs.
